note: Sacks 2026 dosage paper, Fig. 3 joint model (Jon 2026-11-23). One specification for every cohort (UK Biobank, All of Us WGS, All of Us arrays), so the exports can be meta-analysed replicate by replicate. Do not edit per cohort.

cnv_filter.note: Jon 2026-11-23: Fig. 3 uses the PGC freeze filters in every cohort, as the UK Biobank call table was built: >= 10 kb; arrays >= 10 probes; calls carried by > 10% of samples at >= 50% reciprocal overlap removed (applied when the cohort's CNV table is made: aou_sv_to_cnv.py, filter_plink_cnv.py, PGC Freeze_2024). No per-position frequency filter: position_max_freq null. The per-position carrier frequency is recorded (cnv_freq_filter.py). Setting position_max_freq to a number would add the optional position filter in every cohort.
